instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a large blank sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned centrally and dominating almost the entire frame, yet still allowing a visible margin of the floor, background and side elements. The sheet feels premium, refined and tactile, with realistic paper texture, soft matte surface, subtle fibers, clean edges and elegant natural folds. It is presented as a luxurious blank canvas for a car-themed concept, with the paper occupying the visual hero role while leaving enough surrounding space to reveal the environment and composition depth.

The sheet is surrounded by carefully curated automotive-inspired adornments and symbolic elements, arranged organically around its edges and in the side areas, never blocking the central blank space. These elements include sleek classic car details, chrome accents, stylized wheel rims, headlights, speed lines, miniature car silhouettes, garage-inspired props, subtle mechanical components, polished tools, tire textures, road markings, and refined decorative motifs inspired by car culture. The ornaments feel premium, editorial, and intentional, creating a sophisticated theme without clutter. Some elements may appear as floating design accents, others grounded near the floor, contributing to visual balance and storytelling.

The background is a rich, narrative environment related to automobiles — such as a luxury garage, an elegant showroom, a vintage workshop, a cinematic car exhibition, or a stylish road-inspired setting — softly blurred but still recognizable. The floor remains visible and grounded, enhancing spatial realism and allowing the sheet to feel physically placed in the scene. Side elements and background architecture provide depth, context and perspective, while keeping the blank sheet as the unmistakable focal point.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the paper surface, delicate rim light outlining the sheet edges, and subtle volumetric light rays adding atmosphere. Reflections from chrome and metallic details catch the light realistically. Shadows are soft, directional and natural. A faint atmospheric haze and floating dust particles enhance the premium, dreamy mood.

The color palette is intentional and harmonious, inspired by automotive luxury and editorial design: Ferrari red, petroleum blue, mustard yellow, off-white cream, light gray, sand beige, and sage green as a delicate accent. These colors appear in the decorative elements, props, background accents and subtle reflections, creating a balanced and sophisticated visual identity.

Composition: central foreground focus on the blank sheet, nearly full-frame presence, with visible floor, background and side elements for depth and realism. The sheet remains clean, uncluttered and ready for design, while the surroundings reinforce the car theme. Camera: wide-to-medium cinematic perspective with a slight low angle, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the paper texture and nearby adornments, softly defocused background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic editorial realism, luxurious, modern, automotive-inspired, premium presentation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, subtle reflections, refined contrast. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, elegant, visually striking, suitable for premium automotive branding and themed invitations.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão na horizontal elegante nessa mesma atmosfera e mesmo tema (Carros) e mesma paleta de cor (❤️ Vermelho ferrari. 🔵 Azul petróleo. 💛 Amarelo mostarda. 🤍 Off-white (creme). 🩶 Cinza claro. 🤎 Bege areia. 🌿 Verde sálvia (para um toque delicado).), escrito apenas Anthony Caleb, idade 1 Anos.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
The animation begins by focusing on an envelope sealed with a single wax seal. As soon as the wax seal physically detaches and falls to the ground, it is not replaced, duplicated, or regenerated at any point. The envelope remains permanently open after this moment, without any additional seal appearing.
Once the seal is removed, the envelope flap slowly lifts. From within, shimmering sparkles, glittering dust, and trails of radiant light emerge, spreading in a mesmerizing display to the surroundings, with magical beams of luminous particles curving around the envelope, passing in front of and behind it in a three-dimensional spiral. These particles originate only from inside the envelope and also from behind the envelope, increasing in density and brightness as they move.
The radiant light intensifies and expands outward, gradually filling the entire scene. No new physical objects are introduced during this transition. The intense glow of the beams and sparkles transforms into a solid, dazzling white screen in the final frame. The camera subtly and slowly zooms in.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
aberturaSlide4Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
